desc: Read problem and understand operations (swap adjacent, delete uniform prefix)
Analyze sample cases to derive correct formula
Implement compressed run processing with Fenwick tree for active value counting
Verify solution against sample 1 (expected 3), sample 2 (expected 4), and sample 3 (expected 8)
Debug the discrepancy for sample 3 where current approach yields 6 but should be 8
Investigate stack-based formulation: process runs, maintain stack of values, count pushes/pops correctly

Implement the stack-based solution: process compressed runs, maintain stack, for each value v pop while top > v (adding to answer), then if stack empty or top != v, push v and add 1 to answer. This correctly handles nested intervals and alternating patterns.
Test implementation on all three sample cases to verify answers 3, 4, 8
Handle edge cases: single element arrays, arrays where all elements are equal, arrays with all distinct values
Optimize for large inputs: O(N log N) or O(N) per test case, with total N across test cases ≤ 2×10^5
